description: Compare keeping a current mortgage with a CapCenter rate-and-term refinance, a cash-out refinance and a home equity loan, using real CapCenter pricing: new monthly principal and interest, the change, cost to close (ZERO Closing Costs; points shown), break-even months, total interest and estimated benefit over the years the client plans to stay. Flags when keeping the current loan is better. An estimate, not a loan offer. Answers in Spanish with language=es (refinanciamiento).

cash_wanted.description: Cash wanted from home equity, whole dollars (0 or omitted = none).

county.description: Location slug as used on the CapCenter mortgage rates pages, e.g. henrico-county.

credit.description: Credit score band (620 is the minimum).

current_rate.description: Current mortgage interest rate, percent, e.g. 7.25.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

payment.description: Current monthly principal and interest payment only (no taxes, insurance or escrow), whole dollars; computed from rate, balance and years left if omitted.

propertyType.description: sfr (default, single-family home), condo or townhouse.

years_left.description: Years left on the current loan.

years_staying.description: Years the client expects to keep the home and loan.

name: compare_refinance_options
title: Compare refinance options
